name: gated-dev-simple-workflow
description: File-based ticket-to-PR pipeline: /ticket runs spec, plan, dev and review subagents in a worktree per ticket (git, Orca or iTerm2), with a plan-approval checkpoint and PR creation, plus a launcher that opens one session per ticket and notifies you when a launched session needs you. Treats approval-gate prompts as checkpoints; no gate required.
